a.name: Dawnseeker

Believable fictional objects. Animated with kinetic mastery. Tying everything into what feels like a real product.
Clean and groundbreaking projects on the visualizer market. Expert of visual mimicry.

b.name: Reika
b.bio: I run Reyes Picture Co., a three-person studio. My films have played at festivals in Busan, Rotterdam and Singapore. I direct, shoot and colorgrade, which keeps the look consistent from the first test to the final export.
